title: Condense View Profile and Edit Profile into a single unified Profile page flow

requirements.text: Update the profile dropdown menu to remove the separate modal-based "Edit Profile" flow and instead route all profile actions through the single /profile page.

quotes: now condense the view profile and edit profile into one

acceptanceCriteria: The ProfileMenu dropdown no longer shows separate "View Profile" and "Edit Profile" actions that lead to different experiences (page vs modal).
Clicking the profile menu entry navigates to /profile and does not open an edit dialog modal.
No profile editing dialog (Dialog) is rendered from ProfileMenu after this change.

requirements.text: Ensure the /profile page supports both viewing and editing within the same page, including an option to land directly in edit mode when navigated from the profile dropdown (e.g., via a URL query parameter like ?edit=1).

quotes: now condense the view profile and edit profile into one

acceptanceCriteria: /profile continues to show a read-only view mode and an in-page edit mode (no separate edit screen/modal required).
When /profile is opened with an explicit edit indicator (for example, ?edit=1), the page initializes in edit mode.
When /profile is opened without the edit indicator, the page initializes in view mode (current behavior).
After saving or cancelling edits on /profile, the user returns to view mode on the same page and profile data is updated/reflected correctly.

requirements.text: Align user-facing labels in the profile dropdown to reflect the unified experience (e.g., rename the action to "My Profile" or "Profile") and keep all user-facing text in English.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: The profile dropdown presents a single, clear navigation item for profile (label is in English).
There are no remaining English UI strings implying a separate "View Profile" vs "Edit Profile" split from the dropdown.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components); compose them only.
Do not edit immutable hook entrypoints listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep backend architecture unchanged (single Motoko actor); no backend changes are required for this UI consolidation.
nonGoals: Redesigning the profile data model or backend profile CRUD APIs.
Adding new profile fields beyond what already exists (displayName, contactInfo, location, profilePicture, joinedAt).
